listing.name: God of War: Ascension — gow-ascension-pc (otavix010) (otavix010)
listing.summary: Upstream reports first-level and chapter 16 measurements, including a low-end example around 6–7 FPS. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BCUS98232 game with update 1.04, including PS3_GAME and the firmware/decrypted inputs required by upstream’s RPCS3-based preparation.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow gerar.cmd or gerar.ps1 to generate code and build locally. Setup downloads compiler dependencies and RPCS3 public key tables.

warnings: Upstream reports first-level and chapter 16 measurements, including a low-end example around 6–7 FPS. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
